rationale.text: The served source has no title element; a script sets document.title while the page loads, which makes the browser create a title element in head holding that text. The test is about the page as examined: the page then has a title element in head with text, the structure the methodology looks for. The custom check reads the page as established and answers no_fault, so the finding is passed at full and needs_review, not_enabled, at fail_only. This is the shape of pages built by script, where the title exists only in the generated document.

citations.quote: Chaque page web a-t-elle un titre de page (balise `<title>`) ?
Retrouver dans le document le titre structuré au moyen d’un élément `<title>` ;
Contenu de la balise <title> d’une page web
